scope: Candidate-scoped exact support-domain certification for every finite all-retarded and every finite all-advanced plane binary q2/Green tree, together with the complete mixed-sign support grammar, its first four-leaf nondefinition boundary, and a zero-mode witness against silently extending either displayed Green name to the whole opposite support class.

tier_2.criterion: The accepted unary-causal Green certificate and candidate q2/Green first-response certificate were independently replayed before checking the recursive support grammar; producer regeneration was not counted as independent verification.

tier_3.criterion: No classical or quantum freeze, release tag, shared core algebra, lifecycle state, analytic convergence theorem, Hadamard state, QME result or Lorentzian completion was promoted.

foundational_boundary.finite_combinatorial_layer: The plane-tree grammar, Catalan recurrence and finite induction are primitive-recursive and require no choice principle.
foundational_boundary.analytic_layer: The past-/future-compact Green extension is imported from classical smooth completed analysis; the weakest constructive or choice-free base sufficient for that extension remains unresolved.

claim_boundary: This establishes recursive support-domain closure for every finite polarized candidate q2/Green tree and exactly locates the first unrestricted mixed-sign support-domain failure. It does not establish authoritative q2 identity, q3 or higher brackets, an infinite sum or fixed point, analytic convergence, a Hadamard state, renormalized Lorentzian products, QME restoration, residual transfer or a quantum theory.
